title: Add VPC control plane Terraform: subnets, endpoints, security groups, peering, Route53 DNS
author: Aditi Rao
summary: Adds first-class Terraform resources and orchestration for provisioning the VPC control plane used by private deployments: subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account VPC peering, and Route53 private hosted zone configuration.
description:
Motivation:
We need to codify the VPC networking pattern used by private control plane installs so customers can reliably provision subnets, VPC endpoints, security groups, cross-account peering, and Route53 DNS records from Terraform. This reduces manual steps in the private installer and enables deterministic upgrades/rollbacks.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces terraform/modules/control-plane with resources for subnets, IGW/NAT attachments, managed route table entries, interface VPC endpoints (SSM, EC2, KMS, ECR), and security groups tailored for the control plane services.
- Adds cross-account VPC peering support and automated creation of route propagation entries when peering is accepted.
- Adds terraform/modules/control-plane/route53.tf to create and share a Route53 private hosted zone and records for control-plane.* and api endpoints, including optional Resolver rules for on-prem DNS forwarding.
- Adds small Helm values and chart notes to the private-control-plane chart to surface the VPC network IDs and expected SGs for installers.
- Adds docs/private-deploy/vpc-setup.md with the provisioning workflow and a troubleshooting checklist.

Files changed (high level):
- terraform/modules/control-plane/main.tf (new resources for subnets, endpoints, sg)
- terraform/modules/control-plane/route53.tf (private hosted zone + records + delegation options)
- terraform/modules/control-plane/outputs.tf (exports for installer and helm values)
- terraform/modules/control-plane/variables.tf (new variables with sensible defaults and validation)
- terraform/modules/control-plane/peering.tf (cross-account peering + route management)
- helm_charts/private-control-plane/values.yaml (new networking keys)
- docs/private-deploy/vpc-setup.md (operator guide and rollback notes)
- test/terraform/integration/control-plane-terraform-apply.sh (smoke integration test harness)
- small helpers and unit tests under test/terraform (terratest mocks)

Testing and validation:
- Ran terraform fmt and validate in CI.
- Added a terratest-based integration that runs against a dedicated test AWS account (sanitized) to validate subnet creation, endpoints, and peering lifecycle. The integration runs in the infra CI stage and passed in this branch's run.
- Performed manual end-to-end validation in staging: provisioned control-plane VPC, created peering to an example customer VPC, validated DNS resolution of private hosted zone records from both sides after route propagation.

Rollback/Upgrade notes:
- The module is additive; most changes create new resources and export outputs consumed by the private installer.
- Peering creation is controlled by an explicit variable and waits for acceptance; rollback will remove peering and clean up route table entries.
- Route53 delegation uses optional share/association patterns; operators can opt-out to manage DNS separately.

Security considerations:
- Security groups are tightly scoped to control-plane service ports only; KMS endpoints use VPC endpoints and policy scoping.
- Cross-account peering requires explicit acceptance by the target account; we added detailed audit-friendly tags to peering connections and endpoints.

Checklist (items completed):
- [x] Terraform module implemented with variables and outputs
- [x] Module-level unit tests and terratest integration
- [x] Helm chart values surfaced for installer consumption
- [x] Docs and operator runbook added
- [x] CI checks (fmt/validate/terratest/helm-lint) green

Follow-ups (future PRs):
- Add automated acceptance flow for peering via the private installer and documented IAM expectation.
- Expand terraform module to support GCP VPC equivalents (multi-cloud).

Related: ENG-1423 (control plane private deployment networking), SUP-512 (customer support case that motivated resolver rules), PM-98 (product spec).

release_notes: Add new terraform module 'control-plane' to provision VPC subnets, endpoints, security groups, peering, and Route53 private hosted zones for private deployments. Includes docs and CI integration. No breaking changes by default.
notes_for_ops: Be aware: enabling automatic peering will create cross-account peering connections that require manual acceptance in the target account unless configured with the installer automation. Route53 associations may take several minutes to propagate; DNS tests included in the integration test cover this window.
